value.title: Live role detail: output tail, tokens and cost, ASCII charts and animations, bell
Architect on size L, split, slivers
Landing help: ready-to-land list and merge detection

goal.title: One clear owner for each relay step; no step lives in two tools
Keep the outer session's context small by moving deterministic work out of it
Use slicer and adjudicate only through their CLIs and JSON output
Follow slicer's relay contract by version, never by copying its text
One dashboard across projects: roadmaps, decisions and live relays with every agent, stage and progress
After v1: edit and reorder the roadmap from the dashboard, every edit a slicer CLI call
After v1: manage the decision queue from the dashboard, every change an adj CLI call made as the owner
Set up, launch and supervise parallel slice waves across vendors, owner-attended at checkpoints
User experience first: colorful, keyboard-driven TUI with mouse support
Small explicit state: ork owns only its registry, run records and UI preferences
Deterministic before model: tests, slicer check, fingerprint and report shape checked by ork before any model review

non_goal.title: No unattended runs; the owner attends every relay (open: adj scope.attended)
No tracking state of its own for items, slices, specs, readiness or decisions
No reading or writing .slicer/ or decisions/ files directly
No commits, pushes or merges unless the owner authorizes them for a run
Not an LLM; model work stays in the role agents
No scheduler: ork does not pick and run waves on its own
One workflow kind for now: the slice relay; no general pipeline language
